title: Chicken Alfredo
instructions:
ALFREDO
- 1 sticks of butter
- 1 1/2 cups of heavy whipped cream
- 1 1/2 Parmesan cheese
- 3/4 cup of Romano
- A dash of Garlic salt
- A dash of Pepper
CHICKEN
- Soak in Italian dressing (plastic bag)
- Get a Tray
- Foil on tray (Renalds Wraps)
- 350 for 20 min
- Stick in oven
